'''Kento's robe''' was the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robe]] worn by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kento Marek]].

==History==
This special robe was made by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] artisans, who bestowed it to their friend and protector, Kento Marek. Kento wore this robe up until his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|battle of Kashyyyk]].

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] during a [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|mission]] to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Galen Marek]] rediscovered the [[Kento Marek's hut|hut]] where he lived with his [[House of Marek|family]] as a child. Inside the hut, Galen had a brief encounter with his father Kento's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]], who apologized to his son stating that he never want his life to turn out as it did. After the encounter, Galen found his father's robe and [[blue]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] in some rubble behind the hut.

==Behind the scenes==
Kento's robe was featured in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. In the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox|Xbox]] versions, at the very beginning of the Imperial Kashyyyk level players could find a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], one of many hidden throughout the game, in front of the Mareks' hut. The holocron contained a blue lightsaber crystal, which could be speculated to have been Kento Marek's lightsaber crystal. After a brief cinematic inside the hut, players could then backtrack and find another holocron in some rubble behind the hut. This holocron contained Kento Marek's robe that he donned earlier in the game. From that point on it became one of many costumes players could wear in the game.

In the [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PS2]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] versions of the game, the robe is unlocked as a prize for completing the [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|duel with Kento Marek's spirit]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], immediately before the Imperial Kashyyyk mission.
